title: Local speech and third-person weapon grips
summary: Claude-directed follow-up to the radio/render integration: fit Marine hands to the M203, M60 and LAW while preserving crew and crowds. Jay Jay then chose locally built speech banks; generated audio is excluded from the clean handoff. This report retains an intermediate visual defect and a failed browser capture alongside accepted results.
reproduce: Node: node tools/thirdpersongripbench.mjs; node tools/tpgripprofilebench.mjs; node tools/figurecrowdbench.mjs --baseline tools/runs/tp-crowd-before.json --out tools/runs/tp-crowd-after.json; node tools/voicebankbench.mjs; node tools/voicebench.mjs; node tools/check.mjs syntax; node tools/check.mjs types. From tools with CHROME_PATH=/home/jayjay/.cache/chs/chrome.sh: node snap.mjs scenes/radiogripmerge.mjs; scenes/tpm60grip.json; scenes/tpgripcrowd.mjs; scenes/tpgripgame.mjs; scenes/voicebankmissing.mjs; scenes/voices.mjs; scenes/smoke.json. Build the optional speech bank first at the repo root with node tools/voice-build.mjs (WSL + installed Windows US English voices).

changes.title: Hands meet weapon surfaces
changes.change: Solve each wrist from a hand-local grasp frame and per-weapon orientation. Two finite Marine-only diameter profiles use the existing SDF hand/body cache. GL mode places the right index at the launcher trigger and the support hand around the magazine. Raw anchors and weapon geometry stay unchanged.
changes.observed: The M203 palm no longer crosses the upper handguard. GL hands reach the launcher trigger and magazine. LAW palms cradle the tube; a 30-degree support-hand roll clears its sling. The original six camera/projection/weapon transforms match exactly. Final close-ups pass 11 structural assertions; visual inspection and posed-surface checks qualify contact separately.
checks: Six pose groups cover 240 weapon/posture/action states, all three LODs, care entry/release and reset paths.

Twelve meshed hand surfaces pass contact and clearance checks. Primary envelope tests permit up to 3 mm penetration; they are conservative cylinder/box checks, not exact triangle collision everywhere.
The care-release regression is corrected: final M203 rifle step 0.271 mm, GL 0.027 mm and LAW 0.137 mm.
limitations: Broad smooth palms, coarse fingers/thumbs and wrist/watch joins remain visible. This is a bounded fit correction, not a new character model.
The LAW hands cradle its tube; the top trigger pad remains untouched. No authentic trigger-hand or eye-line sight claim.
Static views do not establish every hidden contact or full animation quality.

changes.title: The M60 needed an adjacent-part check
changes.change: The first fitted support hand reached the forearm but intersected a folded bipod foot. Move it another 70 mm rearward and check actual bipod mesh vertices against the posed hand triangles.
changes.observed: The final folded-foot gap is at least 3.453 mm across the tested LODs, while forearm contact remains. The original camera crops the rearward hand, so an additional centred after-only view shows the full grip without changing the comparison camera.
checks: Final centred M60 view: 2/2 structural checks.
Actual adjacent geometry checks also cover the LAW sling, with minimum gaps 3.180 mm left / 0.619 mm right.
limitations: The rejected intermediate capture passed structural assertions. Its visible intersection is retained here because those assertions were insufficient.

changes.title: Shared crew and crowds are unchanged
changes.change: Optional hand profiles affect only Marine geometry on existing LOD mesh objects. Default hand descriptors/cache keys, materials and baked/instanced crew paths are preserved.
changes.observed: All four before/after PNGs are byte-identical: deck crew, townsfolk, and default Marine near/mid LOD. The saved fingerprint of 16 geometries and 3 material contracts remains c8f65bc1a2dd2b88db02573546f0def3fc6628762a71ee2ee66ad330f570315a.
checks: Crowd browser fixture: 7/7 before and 7/7 after.

Nine finite profile combinations reuse caches over four cycles; exact geometry, mesh, material and skeleton identities restore. Invalid profile names are rejected; open-hand requests canonicalize to the existing default cache.
limitations: These are isolated production-model and shader views, not live crowd navigation or performance tests.

The merged-body cache retains 24,577,456 bytes per high-detail appearance for three runtime-used optional combinations; all eight optional combinations would retain 65,510,520 bytes. Claude accepts the desktop cost; Quest/XR memory impact remains unmeasured.

changes.title: Production player and AI adapters use the new grip
changes.change: Stop converting grenade-launcher mode to rifle before posing player and rich AI Marines. Project the existing LAW deployment state into its display model; lightweight AI display follows its existing selected firing intent.
changes.observed: The actual marine.render and groundwar renderUnits paths pass 8/8 checks for GL class/trigger position, folded/deployed LAW parts and AI hand profiles. The first run passed seven checks then Chrome disconnected during the fourth screenshot; that failed artifact is retained. The rerun completed without runtime or console errors.
checks: Real rifleman state is fed through production render adapters. The scene pauses combat scheduling to isolate presentation.
The final inspection camera uses the existing explicit no-overlay post-render option and hides the HUD.
limitations: This does not validate AI combat decisions, a full mission or physical first-person controls.
The browser disconnection cause was not established; it is not reclassified as a passing run.

changes.title: Generated speech stays on the local PC
changes.change: Keep only an unavailable-bank descriptor in Git. node tools/voice-build.mjs generates ignored speech.logpcm.gz and local-index.json using installed Windows voices. The provided server exposes a local bank only when its matching PCM exists and prints a build hint otherwise. Plain static hosting uses silent text call-outs. Live local Windows synthesis remains available.
changes.observed: The missing-bank browser case passes 6/6: normal subtitles, completed queue entries, no audio source/noise and no request for missing PCM. Node checks cover absent/partial/corrupt local builds and load numerical test PCM without relying on installed voices. The normal voice scene uses the preserved local bank and records its SHA-256 separately from the committed game source.
checks: Voice hooks and existing local-bank integrity: 19/19. Server contracts: 13/13.
Final syntax: 617/617; semantic diagnostics 578 against the unchanged 606 ceiling.
Required voices scene: 29/29 with local bank; smoke: 5/5; both zero runtime/console errors. Final game hash 8d8a77cf3e167c7747f48ca5dfd594a51b6d8df1e2810398acc6c2890cbb8e85.
limitations: Missing-bank browser evidence intercepts only the manifest response with the real unavailable descriptor; Node tests separately exercise actual absent/partial files in the server resolver.
Locally generated audio is not bundled with this report or clean history. Earlier bank-containing branch history is retained only for local recovery.
No new physical microphone, Opera listening, headset or actor-quality voice claim.
